**Motif:** Fork

**Explanation (under 80 words):**
Your queen on f6 can jump to c3 with check, forking the White queen and rook simultaneously. White's king must move (or the queen recaptures but loses immediately), leaving both defender pieces hanging. After any king move, you capture the queen on c2 with check, winning material decisively. A fork with check is one of the most forcing patterns in chess—the opponent cannot save both pieces because they must get out of check first.
